name: Naples International Airport (Capodichino)

noise.v: From 19:00 to 06:00 local, landings use RWY 24 (Casoria side), and night take-offs 23:00–06:00 too, when safe and tailwind is 5 kt or less
noise.quote: during evening and night hours (19.00 – 06.00), all landings are to be operated from Casoria (RWY24)

missing: curfew (operator pages conflict: 23:00-06:00 on one page, 22:30-03:30 in the site footer)
notes: GESAC Environment page read. Its footer gives a different closure (22:30–03:30, "except for exceptional flight delays"); confirm with AIP/NOTAM. ENAC said in Jul 2025 that runway works would start in November 2026, and press reports say the airport is closed for all of November 2026: not confirmed from an official notice, so check NOTAM before any November or early December trip. ENAV AIP not opened (registration). Night closure not recorded as a rule: the operator site states "normally closed to air traffic from 23:00 to 06:00" on one page and 22:30-03:30 in its footer; confirm by NOTAM.
